title: Håstad acceptance as an expectation
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $0\leq\delta\leq1$, and let $f:\{-1,1\}^n\to[-1,1]$. The acceptance probability of the Håstad tester with noise parameter $\delta$ equals the expectation, over independent uniform $x,y\in\{-1,1\}^n$ and a uniform sign $b\in\{-1,1\}$, of $\frac{1+b f(x)f(y)(T_{1-\delta}f)(bxy)}{2}$, where $bxy$ is the coordinatewise product and $T_{1-\delta}$ is the noise operator with parameter $1-\delta$.
